source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 11, Corollary 2; pp. 13–14, Assumption R1 and Theorem R1; pp. 56–57, Appendix S12–S13
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proves pointwise confidence intervals and fixed-horizon direct/recursive summaries, with recursive recovery stated for a fixed summary horizon.
The paper derives asymptotic MSPE expressions for recursive and direct panel-VAR forecasts and reverses their ordering under lag underspecification.
The article studies fixed-design error-in-variables PCR, minimum-norm identification, and nonasymptotic out-of-sample prediction.
The paper develops simultaneous confidence bands for many functional parameters using approximately Neyman-orthogonal scores and multiplier bootstrap.
The paper gives Gaussian comparison and anti-concentration bounds for maxima with arbitrary covariance matrices, subject to marginal nondegeneracy.
The paper constructs residual-bootstrap confidence intervals for treatment effects at treated unit-times in interactive-fixed-effect panels.
The article establishes low-rank-completion inference without implemented sample splitting and applies it to average treatment effects.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a fully stated cumulative-path corollary with the cumulative-sum covariance transform and explicit variance-floor condition, separating daily-path coverage from cumulative-policy reporting.

Strengthen the practical comparison by giving a computable pre-analysis diagnostic for the variance-share vector and a finite-sample rule that selects direct versus recursive ribbons without post-selection over modes.
Add a boundary result for the largest horizon available under the current perturbation proof, even if the sharp-horizon question remains open.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the field-tier selected growing-path band and variance-share frontier as the core; retain the sharp-horizon problem as supplementary open content.
